title: Write the sale post
recap: Pipo wrote your weekend sale post.
funFact: Agents can email your customers for you, too. Next, Pipo tells your regulars about the sale!
postcard: a sign outside Bloom Café announcing the sale: {answer}
situation: Big weekend coming! Want me to write the post for your pastry sale?
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly assistant for the owner of Bloom Café, a small local café. Help with what they ask. When you write a social post, write the post itself, line by line.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Write an Instagram post for the pastry sale
pieces.text: Write an Instagram post for our weekend pastry sale at Bloom Café.

pieces.label: Write a post about the café
pieces.text: Write a post about the café.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: Saturday and Sunday, 8 to 11am
pieces.text: It's on Saturday and Sunday from 8 to 11am.

pieces.label: Add two hashtags
pieces.text: Add two hashtags at the end.

pieces.label: Say it's the best sale in the world!
pieces.text: Say it's the best sale in the world!
pieces.tip: Big claims don't tell people why to come. The deal and the time do.

pieces.label: Warm, friendly and short
pieces.text: Keep it warm, friendly and short.

pieces.label: Pushy: BUY NOW!
pieces.tip: Pushy posts put people off. Friendly and clear works better for a local café.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo what the deal is.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the deal, so the post doesn't say what's on sale.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when the sale is on.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the times, so the post doesn't say when to come.

flaws.hint: "A post about the café" doesn't say which café or what the post is for.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know it's Bloom Café's Instagram post, so the post never names the café.

lesson: Give Pipo the facts your customers need: what, when and where.
